title: Antique Brass Glass Shelf With Towel Bar, 16-Inch Wall Mount, Tempered Glass & Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
description: Glass shelf with integrated towel bar, 16 x 5 inch tempered beveled glass (3/8-in thick) with solid brass hardware for bathroom vanity storage and towel hanging — available in Antique Brass, which features a softened, aged golden patina that brings vintage charm and character to traditional spaces. Wall mount glass vanity shelf keeps toiletries organized while the built-in towel bar adds function in a compact footprint. Traditional-to-transitional style for versatile bath accessories and transitional bathroom hardware updates. Includes glass shelf and all installation hardware; uses #8 x 1 1/4" screws. Weight capacity 2 lb. Corrosion-free and rust-free performance with designer finish options. Limited lifetime warranty. Allied Brass Waverly Place collection.
